title: Staff Engineer, Software
description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. DESCRIPTION: Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries. REQUIREMENTS: Master's degree or higher with 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree with 8 years of experience in professional embedded software development Preferred Fields of Study: Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field Expert proficiency in embedded C/C++ Strong experience in RTOS embedded systems including MCU architecture memory maps, interrupt handling, DMA. Experience designing and developing Board Support Packages, HALs, device drivers and embedded software update mechanisms Multithreading, synchronization, concurrency, scheduling latency and resource constraints Hardware interfaces and protocols such as UART, SPI, CAN, RS-485 and USB Experience with Git, build systems, cross-compilation toolchains, and automated firmware builds. Provide technical leadership and strong problem-solving and analytical skills Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and guide teams effectively. Familiarity with relevant standards such as IEC62304
